#    12.758  ERROR: SLOT ROUTING: The robot routes its replies by connection slot, so the probe's S1/S2/S3 must be the 1st/2nd/3rd connections the robot accepted. Likely causes: another client may be connected to the robot (close Slingshot on every computer and any phone app, then power-cycle the robot and run the probe again), or the robot had not yet released the previous session's connections (run again with a longer --slot-release-wait, e.g. 5).
